newsitem.title: BURMA: Four Burmese rapped for working elephant to death.
newsitem.headline: Four Burmese rapped for working elephant to death.

text.p: Four Burmese have been arrested and punished by the military authorities for overworking a state-owned elephant in illegal logging activities until it died of exhaustion, official newspapers reported on Thursday.

An illegal logger, a mahout leader and two mahouts were held for their involvement in the death of the elephant belonging to state firm Myanma Timber Enterprise that they used to pull illegal logs in the northwestern Kalon Forest Reserve.
"One of the two elephants they used to pull the logs died of exhaustion while pulling logs on May 11," one of the newspapers said without detailing their punishment.

Burma claims to have the largest number of tame elephants used for moving timber. The Myanma Timber Enterprise has 2,790 such elephants and private owners have another 500, according to official data.
